verdict.rationale: Docs show proration previews, an entitlements system for granting/revoking feature access, and a 'migrate-subscriptions' migration toolkit — but the migration toolkit as documented is for importing subscriptions from third-party systems (Zuora, Recurly, etc.) into Stripe, not for bulk-moving existing Stripe cohorts to new prices while grandfathering others. Missing for 10: explicit versioned-plan/price-version documentation, explicit grandfathering mechanics for existing subscribers, and evidence of a purpose-built bulk cohort price-migration tool within Stripe itself.
